question: As of October 2020, What is the total count of member states of WHO?
solution:
The correct answer is __**194**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As of October 2020, there are **194 member states** in the World Health Organization (WHO).
 
• The WHO is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for international public health.
 
• It was established on 7 April 1948 and is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
